verses.text: From James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ. To God's people, the twelve tribes scattered around the world: Greetings.
My brothers and sisters, be very glad when you face all kinds of troubles.
You know that when your faith is tested, you learn to keep going.
Let that patience finish its work, so that you will be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
If any of you needs wisdom, ask God for it. He gives freely to everyone and does not find fault, and he will give it to you.
But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt. Someone who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
A person like that should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
They cannot make up their mind, and they are unsteady in everything they do.
Believers who are poor should be proud, because God has lifted them up.
Rich people should be proud when God makes them humble, because they will pass away like a wild flower.
The sun rises with its burning heat and dries up the grass. The flower falls off, and its beauty is gone. In the same way, rich people will fade away, even while they are busy with their plans.
Blessed is the person who stays strong when tested. When they have passed the test, they will receive the crown of life that the Lord promised to those who love him.
When you are tempted, do not say, "God is tempting me." Evil cannot tempt God, and he does not tempt anyone.
People are tempted when their own wrong desires pull them away and trap them.
Then those desires grow and give birth to sin. And when sin is fully grown, it gives birth to death.
Do not be fooled, my dear brothers and sisters.
Every good and perfect gift comes from above, from God our Father, who made the lights in the sky. He never changes or moves like a shadow.
He chose to give us new life through his word of truth, so that we would be the first and best of everything he made.
My dear brothers and sisters, remember this: everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to get angry.
Human anger does not produce the right kind of life that God wants.
So get rid of everything dirty and all the evil around you. Humbly accept the word God has planted in your hearts. It can save you.
Do what God's word says. Do not just listen to it and fool yourselves.
Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like someone who looks at their face in a mirror.
They look at themselves, walk away, and quickly forget what they look like.
But some people look closely into God's perfect law, which sets people free, and keep doing it. They do not forget what they heard, but they do it. They will be blessed in what they do.
If you think you are religious but you do not control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is worth nothing.
Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and good is this: to care for orphans and widows in their troubles, and to keep yourself from being spoiled by the world.
